strategies.name: Pipelined Two-Phase All-Reduce

Execute 8 rounds but with 2-4 chunks in flight simultaneously. Increases dispatch count (8 × chunks all-reduces) but reduces end-to-end latency by exploiting chunk-level parallelism and hiding network latency behind local arithmetic.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Reduce-Scatter All-Gather Pattern

Doubles dispatch count to 16 collectives (8 RS + 8 AG) but reduces per-operation payload by factor of world_size, potentially improving bandwidth utilization at large scale (224 ranks). Trades more dispatches for smaller message sizes.
